name: Geiger
source:
"Thank you for your service."

After years on the battlefield, Darius Creed wants nothing more than silence — a nice quiet life. But peace is a different kind of war, and there's no place for a soldier who only knows how to execute commands. Just when the world feels most distant, he finds a reason to stay. Someone who fought without guns. Someone who made the silence feel like home. Someone more of a hero than himself.

But peace doesn’t last. War always takes away from the undeserving. When everything Darius believes and has is taken away, he must prove he deserves the title of a hero.

[From [url=https://erebuswulfe.itch.io/geiger]Itch.io[/url]]
